source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Current parallel-loop clauses/examples were checked against OpenMP 6.0/Examples 6.0.1; parallel algorithms against the ISO C++ draft; scheduling/reduction patterns against oneTBB and Rayon; floating arithmetic against IEEE 754-2019 and Higham; device execution against NVIDIA CUDA; and vectorization evidence against LLVM documentation. The SIAM DOI resolved but denied automated retrieval, so Higham is used only for established bibliographic/numerical-analysis attribution rather than inaccessible quotations.
